faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: OgaDesk is a WhatsApp CRM. Your whole team answers customers from one shared inbox, and you get contacts, broadcasts, automations, chatbot flows and AI replies on the official WhatsApp Business API.
faq.q2: Do I need a developer or a Meta account?
faq.a2: No developer is needed. You sign in with Meta in a few clicks to connect your number. A Meta business account helps, and OgaDesk guides you through it.
faq.q3: Can I keep my existing WhatsApp number?
faq.a3: Yes. You can link the number from your WhatsApp Business app, or connect a brand-new number.
faq.q4: Can my team share one number?
faq.a4: Yes. Invite teammates with roles and assign each conversation to the right person. Each plan lists how many team members it includes.
faq.a5: Yes. You can start free with one WhatsApp number and a small team, and upgrade when you need more. Broadcasts and AI replies come with the Starter plan and above.
faq.a6: Meta charges its own fees for WhatsApp messages on every provider, separate from your OgaDesk plan. Our pricing guide explains what is free and how it adds up.
faq.a7: Plans are priced in naira. You can switch the display currency to see an approximate price in yours, and the amount you pay is shown at checkout.
faq.q8: Is it the official WhatsApp API?
faq.a8: Yes. OgaDesk uses the official WhatsApp Business Platform from Meta, so your number and your customers stay yours.
